WITH candidate AS (
                SELECT
                    due.id
                FROM
                    email_links l
                    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                        SELECT
                            o.id,
                            o.available_at
                        FROM
                            email_projection_outbox o
                        WHERE
                            o.link_id = l.id
                            AND o.available_at <= now()
                            AND (o.lease_until IS NULL
                                OR o.lease_until < now())
                        ORDER BY
                            o.available_at,
                            o.id
                        LIMIT 1
                        FOR UPDATE
                            OF o SKIP LOCKED) due
                    WHERE
                        l.is_sync_active
                        AND l.provider = $2::text::email_user_provider_enum
                    ORDER BY
                        due.available_at,
                        due.id
                    LIMIT 1)
            -- Every recorded outcome deletes the entry or clears its lease, so a
            -- lease still set here expired under a worker that stopped.
            UPDATE
                email_projection_outbox o
            SET
                lease_id = $1,
                lease_until = now() + interval '3 minutes',
                attempts = attempts + 1,
                unfinished_claims = CASE WHEN o.lease_id IS NULL THEN
                    0
                ELSE
                    o.unfinished_claims + 1
                END
            FROM
                candidate c,
                email_links l
            WHERE
                o.id = c.id
                AND l.id = o.link_id
            RETURNING
                o.id,
                o.link_id,
                o.generation,
                o.payload,
                o.attempts,
                o.unfinished_claims,
                l.sync_generation,
                l.grant_generation
